statement.zh: Bisht《Excavations at Dholavira》(2015 ASI 草稿) 报告 1989–2005 共十四季发掘，记录城堡/中城/下城、城墙、水库与大号文字符号等。
statement.en: Bisht’s Excavations at Dholavira (2015 ASI draft) reports fourteen seasons (1989–2005), documenting citadel/middle/lower town, fortifications, reservoirs, and large script signs.
